name: Desire Riviera Maya Resort
tagline: Best balance of lifestyle energy, dining & romance
location: Puerto Morelos (20 min from Cancun airport)

contact.address: Carretera Costera Norte Sm.10 Mz.26, Puerto Morelos

description: The flagship lifestyle resort of the Desire brand, recently transformed with The Eden renovation (2024) — delivering the perfect fusion of sensual party energy and genuine romance. The new swim-up pool bar with ocean views, Eden suites, and redesigned social spaces elevate the experience. Known for world-class food, staff who truly 'get' the lifestyle, and a packed calendar of themed entertainment.
highlights: Top-rated for food quality (9.3/10) — multiple restaurants, fresh daily menus
Staff consistently praised for lifestyle expertise and professionalism
Packed entertainment calendar: themed nights, sexy contests, fashion shows
Great pool energy with dedicated playmakers and daily competitions
Fitness classes, beach volleyball, water polo, catamaran excursions
Couples-only property — guaranteed adults-only lifestyle atmosphere
Sister resort to Desire Pearl — same brand standards, more social scale
considerations: Can get very crowded during peak season (Dec–Feb)
Less intimate than Pearl due to larger capacity

reviews.name: Jason H
reviews.text: The hospitality staff at DRM is absolutely amazing — bartenders Gustavo, Samuel, and Abraham are top-notch; butlers Cesar and Abel were on top of everything. But Premier management is trying to eliminate beneficiary benefits from existing contracts. We're being told Eros breakfast is now members-only. The Passion Suite is being renamed to prevent us from booking at our contracted rate. Upselling has gotten completely out of control — we were approached for upgrades even while eating at the buffet.

reviews.name: John L
reviews.text: Great food, clean resort, and fun atmosphere — but guests without premium packages face real inconveniences. Pool chairs require arriving by 7am. Different towel colors signal patron status tiers. Dinner reservations require queuing at noon with no guarantee. Advertised catamarans were all 'out of service' all week. Our garden room AC broke twice. Best: restaurants, cleanliness, bartenders, entertainment. Worst: the guest tier system where everything comes down to how much you paid.

reviews.name: Dan M
reviews.text: This was our first visit to Riviera Maya (we prefer the smaller Pearl). The spa was the absolute best part — therapists Jessica, Silvina, Arley, and Grecia were outstanding. Front-of-house team Rosi, Lili, Itzel, and Jesus made everything seamless. As beneficiary members, we did notice a difference in service with recent program changes, particularly at the pool. Still an enjoyable stay with great coffee, comfortable room, and a truly fantastic spa.

response.text: Thank you for sharing your experience. We're delighted the spa was a highlight and that our team provided memorable service. Your feedback about the membership experience has been shared with the appropriate teams for review.

reviews.name: Glenn C
reviews.text: We are seasoned travelers in our early 60s and this became our favorite resort. The food was perfect, drinks top-shelf, and staff amazing. VIP host Alex — new to his position — made our stay absolutely perfect by checking in daily and booking all our restaurants. We tried Pearl for the second week but found it under construction with no pool chairs, and immediately came back to Desire RM where we were greeted like family all over again. Thanks, Alex!

response.text: Thank you so much for sharing this wonderful review. We are truly honored to be your favorite resort experience as seasoned travelers. Alex will be thrilled to hear his care and professionalism made such a lasting impact on your stay.

reviews.name: Zachary
reviews.text: We just got back from our first Desire Riviera Maya trip and had an incredible experience overall. The resort is beautiful, clean, and upscale while maintaining that playful social vibe. Playmakers Pena, Bambam, and Antonella absolutely made our trip — top-tier energy, never making anyone feel uncomfortable. Barista Edgar made every morning better with his coffee and positive attitude. Our only issue: our villa was sold for $1,300 on our final night despite being in our membership contract.

reviews.name: Cora White
reviews.text: Excellent vacation experience as always. Pool attendants work so hard to make sure everyone has what they need. Playmakers Mauricio, Bella, Pina, Bam Bam, Chiarra, and Antonella keep everyone involved and included. Africa and Eduardo at the pool bar are excellent! My only complaint: please bring back the nightly dinner buffet. Requiring reservations for every dinner removes the spontaneous, relaxed atmosphere that makes this resort so special.

response.text: Thank you for continuing to choose us for your vacations. We are delighted you enjoyed the service from our pool team and playmakers. Your feedback about the dining experience is greatly valued and has been shared with our team.

reviews.name: laney f
reviews.text: Our experience is always one of feeling safe, sexy, and satisfied. An absolute must for any couple is the erotic massage — the talented Arey and Nayey gave my wife and I an orgasmic experience we look forward to every single visit. Reserve a pool spot early, but don't feel over-obligated to make dinner reservations every single night.

reviews.name: Jennifer G
reviews.text: Perfect! Great! Will be back again! Just got back from our March stay and can't stop thinking about it. Already planning our next trip back.

response.text: Thank you so much for your wonderful feedback! We're thrilled you had a great stay and look forward to welcoming you back again very soon.

reviews.name: Brittany D
reviews.text: This was our sixth time at Desires in Cancun. I absolutely love it. We have the best time ever!! Ivan at the main pool bar is so sweet and he makes the best mint Mojitos. DJ Motherfukar played great country music at the pool. My favourite theme night was neon cowboy. The live band was so much fun. Edgar at the breakfast coffee hut is so sweet and makes great vanilla lattes. I appreciated Daniel the Butler sending the schedule via text. I think all of the playmakers are so sweet and fun, especially Crystal. Africa one of the servers at the pool is amazing. I really enjoyed the wine and charcuterie board tasting night.

reviews.name: Chris C
reviews.text: What an excellent trip and a lovely spa and fun experience. We have to name a few people who really made the trip great. Thanks to our butlers Daniel and Cesar. Thanks to the playmakers, especially Candace. Thanks to the servers, especially Africa and Jorge. All of you made it a better experience.

response.text: Dear Chris, thank you so much for your kind review! We are delighted to hear that you had such a fun and memorable experience with us. Daniel, Cesar, Candace, Africa, and Jorge will be happy to know their service made a difference. We truly appreciate your recognition and look forward to welcoming you back again soon!

reviews.name: Mitchell S
reviews.text: Excellent sensual massage with Julio and Arely. They gave an excellent massage — and very sensual. Highly recommend trying the fantasy massage. Ask for Julio and Arely.

response.text: Dear Mitchell, thank you for sharing your experience. We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed your spa visit and that Julio and Arely provided such a memorable and attentive service. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon.

reviews.name: Wayne V
reviews.text: We have been loyal Canadian members of Desire Pearl and Desire Riviera Maya since 2007 and have visited both resorts many times. We always appreciated the unique atmosphere, freedom, and sense of community these resorts once offered. The staff throughout the resort were absolutely amazing during our stay — the service staff continue to work incredibly hard. Unfortunately, after our most recent experience, it feels like the resort is slowly pricing out many long-time loyal guests while simultaneously reducing overall value. For May 2027 the exact same room category pricing has gone from approximately $542 USD per night to roughly $881 USD per night — an increase of over 60%. During our May stay, occupancy Monday through Wednesday appeared to be only around 50%. Several restaurants were closed those days. The rooms are relatively modest in size and the resort is beginning to show its age. We sincerely hope management takes a serious look at where things are heading.

response.text: Dear Guests, thank you for taking the time to share such a detailed review and for your long-standing loyalty since 2007. We truly value the trust you have placed in us and appreciate your honest feedback. We are sincerely grateful for your kind words about our team. Your comments regarding pricing and overall value have been shared with the appropriate departments. Should you wish to share additional details, please feel free to contact us directly at guestservice@desireresorts.com.

reviews.name: Sandinmytoes60
reviews.text: This was our 9th trip to Desire. It is a place like no other. The vibe is friendly and sexy — a couples-only, adult, clothing-optional resort. You can wear as little or as much as you want on the immaculate grounds. Two pools: one party pool and one quiet pool. Six different restaurants. The main pool has the Playmakers — this vibrant bunch keeps the fun going and the music on. There are usually less than 300 guests here, and the service is outstanding. The restaurants are very good, especially for an all-inclusive. Each night has a theme in the lobby bar entertainment space with lots of people dressed in theme costumes. There is nightly entertainment until 11pm, then the disco opens. Ready to go back in October!

response.text: Thank you so much for sharing such a wonderful review and for choosing Desire Riviera Maya time and time again. We are truly honored to know this was your 9th visit. Knowing you are already looking forward to returning in October means the world to us. We cannot wait to welcome you back for more unforgettable moments in paradise!

reviews.name: Brett H
reviews.text: Great massages by Ailin and Estrella. Staff so welcoming — Rossy and Lilianee.

response.text: Dear Guests, thank you so much for sharing your kind feedback. We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed the spa massages with Ailin and Estrella, and that Rossy and Lilianee made you feel so warmly welcomed. We look forward to welcoming you back again very soon.

reviews.name: LoyalMember_DRM
reviews.text: Wonderful trip overall. The gardens and grounds are stunning and set this resort apart visually from any other all-inclusive in Mexico. The themed nights are a highlight of every visit. Pool bartenders are excellent. Staff friendliness is a genuine standout. Some minor food quality inconsistencies across outlets but nothing that detracted significantly from the experience. Would recommend.
